cells.gaps: Whether the authorities recognise the Côte d'Ivoire Identité app's ID is not established; a national authentication platform and wallet are only at feasibility study.
cells.note: The Côte d'Ivoire Identité app, released in August 2025 with ONECI, holds the national ID card on a phone behind biometric login and issues documents authenticated by ONECI (CIV-013, CIV-012); e-signature is used across administrations (CIV-005). Staged on the rung as worded; read as needing a state wallet, it is stage 4.
